verdict.rationale: Rive's docs state that it supports building "responsive layouts" and experiences that respond to screen size. Layouts also appear as first-class objects that the AI agent and MCP tools can generate and that data binding can drive. However, the evidence is only brief marketing-level mentions and never describes how frames actually resize. Missing for 10: documented auto-layout behavior (direction, spacing, padding, hug/fill), constraint/pinning controls, layout grids, in-depth editor docs on responsive resizing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
